name: snRNA-seq of human optic nerve and optic nerve head - all cells
description: For over 900,000 snRNA-seq cells, we identified 25 major cell classes and 86 sub classes/cell types/cell states in the human optic nerve and optic nerve head.

labelsets.name: author_cell_type
labelsets.description: We used scVI for data integration and then manually annotated each cell cluster based on marker gene expression
